speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Jersey Finger (Flexor Digitorum Profundus Avulsion)

The clinical picture of an avulsion injury with inability to flex the distal interphalangeal joint and the resting extension of the finger is classic for a "jersey finger." The patient's history of getting caught in a jersey while playing football confirms the mechanism. A right hand X-ray was requested to assess for an associated fracture or to visualize tendon retraction, which are critical for surgical planning.

DIAGNOSIS_READY_Answer: Rupture of the flexor digitorum profundus tendon at its point of insertion
